newsitem.title: USA: Johnson Controls in Asian market push - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Controls in Asian market push - WSJ.

text.p: Johnson Controls Inc will announce Thursday plans to acquire an auto-parts supplier in Australia and form a joint venture with another auto-parts maker in China, the Wall Street Journal reported.
Johnson will acquire Aldersons, an auto-interiors unit of Tutt Bryant Industries PLY Ltd, of Sydney, Australia.

In Beijing, Johnson will form a joint venture with Beijing Automotive Industry Corp to make auto interiors for Chinese car manufacturers. The joint venture will be controlled by Johnson, and will build a 420,000-square-foot plant in Beijing, according to the article.
The company is not expected to announce the financial terms of either deal, the Journal said.
Johnson Controls' moves are part of a broader effort by the company to achieve a 20-percent market share in Asia by the year 2000, the article said.
